column3: (Anti-clickjacking header: GitHub Pages cannot send headers; frame-ancestors is not allowed in a CSP meta tag)
(X-Content-Type-Options: header, set by GitHub Pages in production, not by the CI test server)
(CSP header not set: the CSP is delivered as a meta tag, GitHub Pages cannot send headers)
(Server version header: comes from the Python test server in CI, not from GitHub Pages)
(Permissions-Policy header: GitHub Pages cannot send headers)
(Cross-origin isolation headers: GitHub Pages cannot send headers; the site loads nothing cross-origin)
(Strict-Transport-Security: GitHub Pages does not send HSTS for custom domains; HTTPS is enforced in the Pages settings)
(CSP without frame-ancestors: that directive only works as an HTTP header, GitHub Pages cannot send headers)
(Access-Control-Allow-Origin *: set by GitHub Pages; harmless for a public site without logins or private data)
(Cache-control directives: set by GitHub Pages and its CDN; informational)
(Retrieved from cache: the GitHub Pages CDN; informational)
(Cross-domain JavaScript source: the site promises no third-party scripts)
(Cookie without HttpOnly: the site promises no cookies)
(Cookie without Secure flag: the site promises no cookies)
(Cookie without SameSite: the site promises no cookies)
